rubric_hint.rule: 2 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: Notification is a 4.11 ha regeneration felling (Föryngringsavverkning) in Norrtälje, status 'notified'. Completed felling overlaps only 0.5% of the polygon (2014), so not ALREADY_FELLED.

No eligible species within 250 m. Two threatened, forest-associated, felling-relevant, site-bound species are recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m: Goodyera repens (VU, 665 m, 2025, unc 10 m) and Albatrellus citrinus (VU, 667 m, 2023, unc 15 m). This matches the rubric MEDIUM rule.

Five site-bound forest NT fungi are recorded within 250 m, one of them at 0 m (Leptoporus erubescens, 2022). This is above the 3-species MEDIUM threshold. These records are low-uncertainty (1–10 m) and 2022–2025. The NT species are not counted as eligible.

Recording effort is adequate: 516 records within 1000 m against a county median of 42 (92nd percentile). Within 250 m there are 58 records, 44 species and 6 observation days. The near-site record content therefore reflects real recording, not an effort gap.

uncertainties: Records show species were recorded, not that they occupy the felling site today.
The VU species are about 665 m away, and the polygon's equivalent radius is 114 m. Their habitat may differ from the stand.
The NT fungi records are from 2022–2025. Their present status is unknown.
not_established: Whether any red-listed species occurs in the stand to be felled.
Forest character or stand age: the tools do not state it.
Whether felling is legal or harmful.
Absence of other species, including sensitive species hidden in public data.
next_action: A reviewer should check the polygon against the NT fungi records at 0–223 m, especially Leptoporus erubescens (0 m). They should also consider a field or habitat check before the six-week period ends. They should view the GBIF records for the two VU species at about 665 m.
